summary: Phase E frontend verification on preview as admin@kkt.in (Super Admin). Scenarios covered: login + demo chips, Leads board drag/undo, Service kanban move/undo, FlatDrawer status change + undo, Customer 360 request count, keyboard shortcuts (/ and Ctrl+K), Settings System Health + /api/admin/ops shape, Payments date aria-labels, Customers phone aria-labels, error-toast Request ID. 8 of 9 user-facing checks PASS. Two concrete deviations found: (1) '/' key does NOT focus the search input on /customers; (2) System Health card in Settings UI does not render the new 'avg queries' column even though /api/admin/ops.requests.by_group.<group>.avg_queries is correctly populated by the backend (verified live: admin.avg_queries=3.3, cache {hit:29, miss:73}). Note: no leads column has >50 cards in current seed (max 42 in New), so the load-more UI could not be user-exercised; code review confirms data-testid=load-more-<stage> is wired in Leads.jsx L147.

ui_bugs.issue: Route-group table does NOT render 'avg queries' column, although /api/admin/ops.requests.by_group.<group>.avg_queries is populated by backend. Current table columns: ROUTE GROUP, COUNT, P50, P95, P99, DB P95, 4XX/5XX. 'avg queries' is missing from the header row and each row.

integration_issues.issue: Pressing '/' while focus is on BODY (not in an input) does NOT shift focus to the customers search input. activeElement remained BODY. Ctrl+K (opens palette) and Esc (closes palette) both work correctly. Likely the global '/' handler in CommandPalette only focuses the palette search box, not the Customers page search input, or it does not fire when `/customers` page-local search input is present.

Navigating to /customers/CUST-2526-0001 fetches /api/customers/CUST-2526-0001 + /panels, then redirects to /customers/<uuid> which fetches customer + panels + ledgers + timeline (plus shell /settings/company, /notifications/unread-count, /customers/rm-options, /catalogues). Total 10 /api calls; zero duplicate URLs. Navigating directly to the uuid URL would yield only 4 page-specific /api calls which does meet the ≤5 target. The slug→uuid redirect doubles the customer+panels fetch pair. Suggestion: either keep the slug URL and avoid the client-side redirect (resolve on server), or hide the panels fetch behind the uuid-resolved customer.

action_items: Add 'avg queries' column to the System Health route-group table (Settings page). Backend already exposes requests.by_group.<group>.avg_queries. Also surface cache {hit,miss} ratio since the API already returns it.
Fix the '/' keyboard shortcut on /customers so it focuses the page search input (data-testid=customers-search or similar) when focus is on BODY. Ctrl+K palette path is unaffected and works.
critical_code_review_comments: ServiceRequests.jsx uses native HTML5 draggable (`<div draggable onDragStart/onDrop>`), which Playwright's drag_and_drop + synthesized DnD events do not reliably reproduce in headless Chromium. The arrow-key fallback via moveKeyProps(cols, s, onDrop) worked perfectly (focus the card wrapper, press ArrowRight → toast with Undo). This is good a11y, but automated DnD tests should use the keyboard path or expose MoveMenu testids under all breakpoints (currently narrow-only).

FlatDrawer.jsx — status buttons work and toast 'V1 is now Hold / Was Available / Undo' renders correctly with an Undo action (data-testid=flat-status-hold-btn). Only testing quirk: the Rooms table rows inside the drawer intercept pointer events on the Sonner toast if the toast overlaps the drawer; may want higher z-index on toasts.

/api/admin/ops shape: top-level keys are {generated_at, uptime_s, startup, process, requests, jobs, read_models, cache, db_pool}. by_group lives under `requests.by_group` (not top-level). Documentation / testers assuming top-level `by_group` would be misled.
Login page: demo chips (data-testid=demo-super-admin etc.) correctly set aria-pressed=true and inverted bg (bg-ink-950 text-warm-50) when selected. Good.
Leads v2 drag flow: drag source + target + toast + Undo + confirmation toast ('P9 Visitor 0 back in New') all behave as spec'd. Clean implementation.

success_rate.frontend: 8/10 checks pass (System Health avg_queries column missing; '/' key on /customers does not focus search). Load-more UI not exercised due to seed data having max 42 cards per column.

test_credentials: admin@kkt.in / Kkt@12345 (Super Admin, from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Demo chip data-testid=demo-super-admin auto-fills.
seed_data_creation: None. All stage/status moves undone immediately via Undo toast (verified rollback). Flat V1 Hold state was NOT undone from Playwright (test click flaky due to drawer rows intercepting), but there is an open sonner toast with a working Undo button that a user would click; main agent should either (a) manually revert V1 to Available via the live app, or (b) trust that the undo toast works as the UI confirms. API call still records in audit.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Service kanban uses native HTML5 drag (`draggable` attr) — Playwright synthesized drag events do NOT fire the onDrop handler. Use keyboard: focus `[data-testid="sr-drag-<ticket>"]` and press ArrowRight/ArrowLeft (moveKeyProps). Leads board uses the Leads v2 drag which works with Playwright's mouse.down/move/up pattern. FlatDrawer status buttons: `[data-testid="flat-status-reason"]` + `[data-testid="flat-status-hold-btn"]`. Villa Block P block id: 780734e0-014d-4be2-b548-af9adf6329a1 (V1 was flipped to Hold during this run — may want to flip back). /api/admin/ops payload: by_group is under `requests.by_group` not top-level. The '/' shortcut CommandPalette.jsx handler needs to also focus the current page's search input when a page search exists (currently it does nothing on /customers).
rca of the issue: System Health avg_queries missing column — Settings page System Health card renders the route-group table from /api/admin/ops but only pulls COUNT/P50/P95/P99/DB P95/4XX/5XX columns from the response. The new backend field `requests.by_group.<group>.avg_queries` (added per spec, backend confirmed returning 3.3 for admin group) is not wired into the UI table. Fix: in the SystemHealth component JSX, add a column `AVG Q` sourced from `g.avg_queries`. Keyboard '/' not focusing /customers search — CommandPalette.jsx registers a global '/' handler but it probably only triggers palette-local focus; the per-page search inputs on /customers (and likely /leads, /bookings, /payments) are not wired as the global focus target. Fix: either (a) have CommandPalette dispatch a custom event (e.g. 'ui.focus-page-search') that each list page listens for and focuses its own search input, or (b) have each page's search input carry a known data-testid (e.g. page-search) and the global handler query & focus it when present on the current route.
